snippet.title: A Storied Life: Tabitha | Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
How would you like to be remembered?

In A Storied Life: Tabitha, you arrive at the house of someone close who has recently passed away. Picking through the items that made up this person’s life, you’ll choose what stories you want to tell from their past, using the belongings they’ve left behind.

A Storied Life: Tabitha is a cozy narrative game about memory, legacy, discovery, and joy, from the team at Lab42 Games and published by Secret Mode.

Find out more and wishlist A Storied Life: Tabitha on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749330/A_Storied_Life_Tabitha
